inputs.text: DSD athletes also face exclusion from future Olympics, because the IOC says this move will protect fairness and safety. The International Olympic Committee has banned transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category of events at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games in a landmark decision. Kirsty Coventry, the president of the IOC, said: “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.”
